+"""RoboPaint episode driver and recorded stroke planner.
+
+Run in one live rcb-limited episode.  The practice mode probes brush footprint;
+the paint mode executes the traced target strokes and writes execution records.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+import json, math, os, sys, time
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = "/app/runs"
+QDOWN = np.array([0., 1., 0., 0.], dtype=float)
+MAIN_C = (-0.100, 0.000)
+PRACTICE_C = (-0.100, -0.1856)
+SHEET_Z = .020
+MM = .227185
+
+def main_xy(u, v):
+    """Main-sheet image pixel centre to world xy."""
+    X, Y = (u + .5) * MM / 1024, (v + .5) * MM / 1024
+    return (-.100 + .1135925 - Y, .1135925 - X)
+
+def practice_xy(x_mm, y_mm):
+    """Practice millimetres (X right, Y toward robot) to world xy."""
+    return (-.100 + .1135925 - y_mm / 1000,
+            -.1856 + .0496965 - x_mm / 1000)
+
+class Path:
+    def __init__(self, pose):
+        self.pose = np.array(pose, dtype=float)
+        self.rows = []
+    def to(self, xyz, speed=.12):
+        dst = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), QDOWN]
+        dist = np.linalg.norm(dst[:3]-self.pose[:3])
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(dist / (speed*.05))))
+        for k in range(1, n+1):
+            self.rows.append(self.pose + (dst-self.pose)*(k/n))
+        self.pose = dst
+    def hold(self, seconds=.15):
+        n=max(1, int(round(seconds/.05)))
+        self.rows.extend([self.pose.copy() for _ in range(n)])
+    def dip(self, center, z=.0245):
+        self.to([center[0],center[1],.06], speed=.12)
+        self.to([center[0],center[1],z], speed=.04)
+        self.hold(.20)
+        self.to([center[0],center[1],.06], speed=.04)
+    def line(self, a, b, z=.0185, speed=.05):
+        self.to([a[0],a[1],.05], speed=.10)
+        self.to([a[0],a[1],z], speed=.025)
+        self.hold(.15)
+        self.to([b[0],b[1],z], speed=speed)
+        self.to([b[0],b[1],.05], speed=.025)
+        self.hold(.10)
+
+def run_rows(robot, path, tag):
+    if not path.rows: return None
+    result=robot.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(path.rows), dt=.05,
+        cameras=("canvas_cam","practice_cam","scene_cam","side_cam"),
+        video_fps=4, video="none", note=tag)
+    print(tag, "rows",len(path.rows),"plan",result.meta.get("plan"),
+          "steps",result.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),
+          "time_left",result.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+    return result
+
+def observe(robot, folder):
+    os.makedirs(folder,exist_ok=True)
+    obs=robot.get_obs(cameras=("canvas_cam","practice_cam","scene_cam","side_cam"),video="none")
+    for name,arr in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(arr).save(os.path.join(folder,name+".png"))
+    with open(os.path.join(folder,"obs.json"),"w") as f: json.dump(obs.meta,f,indent=2)
+    print("observation",obs.meta.get("time_left_s"),obs.meta.get("proprio",{}).get("now"))
+    return obs
+
+def practice():
+    robot=Robot()
+    os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
+    with open(OUT+"/spec.json","w") as f: json.dump(robot.spec(),f,indent=2)
+    obs=observe(robot,OUT+"/000")
+    now=np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"],float)
+    path=Path(np.r_[now[7:10],now[10:14]])
+    wells=robot.spec()["static"]["wells"]["wells"]
+    well={w["name"]:np.array(w["center_xy"],float) for w in wells}
+    path.dip(well["paint07"])
+    # A slow, lightly pressed line and a faster, more deeply pressed line.
+    path.line(practice_xy(30,115),practice_xy(75,115),z=.019,speed=.035)
+    path.line(practice_xy(30,145),practice_xy(75,145),z=.0165,speed=.075)
+    # A stationary contact probes the round brush's dab diameter.
+    p=practice_xy(53,175)
+    path.to([p[0],p[1],.05]); path.to([p[0],p[1],.0175],speed=.025); path.hold(.45); path.to([p[0],p[1],.05],speed=.025)
+    res=run_rows(robot,path,"practice brush calibration")
+    if res: res.save(OUT+"/001_practice")
+    observe(robot,OUT+"/002")
+    print("status",robot.status())
+
+if __name__=="__main__":
+    mode=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else "practice"
+    if mode=="practice": practice()
+    else: raise SystemExit("use mode practice or paint")
*** End Patch";

+            p8=a[1:-1,:-2]; p9=a[:-2,:-2]; p1=a[1:-1,1:-1]
+            ns=(p2+p3+p4+p5+p6+p7+p8+p9)
+            seq=(p2,p3,p4,p5,p6,p7,p8,p9,p2)
+            trans=np.zeros_like(p1)
+            for x,y in zip(seq[:-1],seq[1:]): trans += ((x==0)&(y==1))
+            if phase==0:
+                c1=(p2*p4*p6)==0; c2=(p4*p6*p8)==0
+            else:
+                c1=(p2*p4*p8)==0; c2=(p2*p6*p8)==0
+            rem=(p1==1)&(ns>=2)&(ns<=6)&(trans==1)&c1&c2
+            n=int(rem.sum())
+            if n:

+        if not changed: break

+def _neighbors(pt, pixels):

+        q=(r+dr,c+dc)
+        if q not in pixels: continue
+        # Suppress redundant diagonal edges around right-angle corners.
+        if dr and dc and ((r+dr,c) in pixels or (r,c+dc) in pixels): continue
+        out.append(q)
+    return out
+
+def graph_paths(sk):
+    pixels=set(map(tuple,np.argwhere(sk)))
+    if not pixels: return []
+    adj={p:_neighbors(p,pixels) for p in pixels}
+    seen=set(); paths=[]
+    # Walk each edge from endpoints and junctions until the next graph node.
+    for start in sorted(pixels):
+      if len(adj[start])==2: continue
+      for nxt in adj[start]:
+        edge=tuple(sorted((start,nxt)))
+        if edge in seen: continue
+        path=[start,nxt]; seen.add(edge); prev,cur=start,nxt
+        while len(adj[cur])==2:
